Welcome! I'm really glad you're joining me on this journey—because what we're about to explore isn’t your typical story of achievement or personal branding. You know how the world loves to celebrate outward success, the kind that fills up résumés and draws applause? Well, The Road to Character by David Brooks invites us to look a little deeper, and ask—what about the qualities that shape who we truly are on the inside?
Brooks draws this fascinating line between what he calls the “résumé virtues”—all those skills and wins that get you noticed—and the “eulogy virtues”—the kindness, humility, and integrity that people remember about you when you’re gone. Together, we’ll explore how these inner qualities sometimes get overshadowed by the push for external success—but why they matter so much more than we might think.
Through stories drawn from history, psychology, and the real lives of remarkable people, Brooks takes us on a path that’s rich with insight and inspiration. We’ll meet individuals who, often through struggle and setbacks, found meaning in self-discipline, sacrifice, and honest self-reflection. Their journeys remind us that the real measure of a life isn’t found in trophies or titles, but in the quiet strength and resilience we build along the way.
So, let’s set out together and discover how adversity and self-examination can help us become more grounded, compassionate, and substantial human beings. This isn’t about chasing perfection—it’s about growing, learning, and maybe even redefining what it means to leave a meaningful legacy. Ready to dive in? Let’s see what The Road to Character has in store for us, with a little help from David Brooks.
